gameDissections.evidenceSummary: In G05 (map=22, 1541x1080, land=664,497, 6 teams), pre-d590acd findVirtualSquadAnchor anchored on a small northern landmass and clusterMax<=350 forced 6 of 8 bots into the voronoi=500 fallback, trapping ethan21 on a 479px pocket (1180,1060). Because g.t<1500 only calls tryEmergencyBossRescue (which returns false when bossId=-1) and neut=3 (<minCmd) blocked boxedIn=true, ethan21 sat at d=111.9..150.0 (71,850 bal, 150*L hard cap, 0% interest) from t=990 to t=1500 without donating a single troop while frontline carry dave_w (L=11,350..16,065, 215 cmds) was drained to d=0.0..3.4 by totB=B+myOut and oppFloorCap=38. At t=1500..1526 ethan21 fired 7 duplicate expandNeutral commands burning 28,520 troops for 6px, then made only 2 tiny 5% donations (t=1528 rejected by ao.ei, t=1546 2.25k delivered / 2.77k tax) before dying via boats.

79 donations (69 accepted, 10 rejected by ao.ei; 15 rear-to-rear ping-pong donations). Because engine donation tax is a flat 64/1024 (6.25% of total donor balance B) per call, capping pct at 51 (~5.08% B) burned 6,101k troops in tax to deliver 4,957k troops (55.17% loss rate). Worse, frontline #1 carry leo_tx (L=28,816, B=3.38M) triggered squad-rescue donations at t=3966 and t=3984, draining 728k troops (402k burned in tax) from the main frontline.

variableEvaluations.causalMechanism: In live_game_js.js (bD.gv.rB & bD.gv.n4), donation fee is a flat 64/1024 = 6.25% of the donor's ENTIRE balance B on every call, plus ao.ei (function ca) adds a fixed +2/+4 per-donation anti-feeding quota penalty before t=4284. Capping pct at 51 (5.08% B) in d996be6 inverted the tax ratio so 6.25% B tax > 5.08% B delivered (burning 18.71M troops in tax to deliver 15.20M across G01-G09, and causing 55/100 rapid donations to be silently rejected by ao.ei). Meanwhile, missing tryDonateToTeammate before t=1500 and requiring neutral===0 trapped G05's ethan21 at 150*L hard cap (0% interest) for 540 ticks, while clamping safeAt(g,-1) to oppFloorCap=38*L and omitting nb===0 from isPureInlandSafe drained 4.47M troops from active frontline fighters.

topCoreVariableRanking.oneLineReason: oppFloorCap=38 + totB=B+myOut + keep<=10~26*L drained frontline home density to 0.3~18 (e.g., G05 dave_w d=0.0~3.4 on 16k land), making frontline bots defenseless against enemy counter-pushes.
Pre-d590acd VirtualSquadAnchor landed on small islands/peninsulas in Boss-less games, causing 6/8 bots in G05 to hit voronoi=500 fallback and lose the main continent at t=0.

pct=51 (5% B) micro-donations against the engine's flat 6.25% B tax burned 18.71M troops (55.2% loss), exhausted ao.ei quotas (55% rejected), starved G05 pre-t1500 at 150*L, and drained 4.47M from frontline pillars.
Tightening allyMinSep<=112 and clusterMax<=350 boxed 2~4 interior bots into nb=0 early and starved the squad's total neutral land capture.
tryInterceptEnemyBoats allowed up to 35% B per chase boat (20 intercepts in G05), draining ryan_m from d=43.1 to d=14.2 right before his collapse.
